requirements.minimum: Both sides executable at the candidate's median clip (>=20 shares) for a MAJORITY of in-window time; >=50% of time at q20+
requirements.justification: 81.6% of events reach matched inventory and median fill is 19.22 shares; a venue that is one-sided most of the time cannot produce a matched majority.

requirements.minimum: A sub-$1 pair must be SEQUENTIALLY reachable within ~168s of the first fill (p90), with median ~49s. A venue whose sequential sub-$1 reach median exceeds 168s FAILS.
requirements.justification: first-fill -> first matched increase: median 49s, p90 168s. After a higher-price EXTEND the next COMPLETE lands in a median 28.4s.

requirements.minimum: >=30 own-trade opportunities per minute, i.e. a venue tape supporting a ~2.0s inter-fill cadence. <=5 prints/min of TOTAL venue flow cannot host it.
requirements.justification: median inter-fill gap 2.0s => ~30 own trades/min sustained.

requirements.minimum: >=900s (15m) windows dominant. 300s windows are a minority habitat and cannot carry a 168s p90 complement budget plus patient compression.
requirements.justification: pre-incentive 15m: 3,391 events / 313,774 fills vs 300s: 2,861 events / 22,566 fills -- 93% of fills are 15m.

requirements.minimum: Touch depth >=20 shares both sides (median clip 19.22) and ladder capacity for a $316 median / $1,131 p90 event outlay.
requirements.justification: median fill 19.22 shares; median event outlay $316, p90 $1,131.

requirements.minimum: Top-of-book single-leg spread <=0.02 so that a higher-price EXTEND costs ~1 tick, not ~20c. A median >=0.10 spread FAILS: it exceeds the entire 0.0280 compression the EXTEND buys.
requirements.justification: higher-extend compression is -0.0280 [-0.0301,-0.0259]; achieved pair-cost median 0.9679 i.e. 3.2c of total edge per pair.

requirements.minimum: Unrebated maker P&L per contract must be better than -$0.0046 (the all-in incentive). Measured maker toxicity worse than that FAILS.
requirements.justification: L5 all-in incentive is $0.004554/contract; it cannot fund a materially negative maker edge.

requirements.minimum: Taker-only fee no worse than 0.07*p*(1-p)*shares (<=1.75c/contract at p=0.5), and ZERO maker fee. A flat 10% notional fee FAILS outright.
requirements.justification: charged fees -$29,136 against +$80,652 matched-pair economics; fee form measured as 0.07*p*(1-p)*shares, taker-only.

requirements.minimum: Not required to be positive, but any venue relying on rebates to clear R7 must have them CREDITED and source-accounted. $0 credited => rebates contribute $0.
requirements.justification: L5 all-in incentive $0.004554/contract -- small; the candidate's +$19,596 measured cash is not incentive-dependent.

requirements.minimum: Sustains concurrency 2 and a $316 median event outlay without moving the book; i.e. the sub-$1 sequential reach must hold at q20-q25, not only q1.
requirements.justification: concurrency peak 2; median event outlay $316, p90 $1,131; median clip 19.22 shares.

L5_comparison.statement: L5 averages 53.8 own fills per event. The ENTIRE venue-wide flow of a Gemini BTC5M window is a median of 5 prints. To trade at L5's cadence our account would have to BE roughly 11x the whole venue's print count, and ~30x its per-minute flow. Note the median inter-print gap is 1.95s, superficially close to L5's 2.0s inter-fill gap, but that is burst clustering (p25 0.04s, p75 21.0s) inside a window holding only 5 prints in total -- it is NOT a sustainable 30 trades/min.

R1_two_sided_fill_frequency: both-sides executable falls to 68.2% at q5 and 61.7% at q25 (n=24,520 obs / 61 windows); but the binding fact is that a sub-$1 pair is available in only 8/17 windows, so matched inventory cannot reach 81.6%
R2_complement_switch_latency: sequential sub-$1 reach is 0.0% within 60s and 11.8% within 120s; median first-lock 174.6s vs the 168s p90 budget and 49s median (n=17 windows)
R3_trade_density: ~4 prints per 5-minute window venue-wide (~0.8/min) against a >=30 own-trades/min requirement -- short by ~1.5 orders of magnitude
R4_window_duration: 300s windows; 93% of L5's pre-incentive fills are in 15m windows and a 300s window cannot hold a 168s p90 complement budget plus compression
R5_depth: sub-$1 availability is size-invariant across q1/q5/q10/q25 (8/17 windows, 532.1 open seconds at every size); median touch 500 on the 15m tape
R6_spread: CORRECTION: recomputed single-leg top-of-book spread from the raw tape is median 0.02 (p90 0.02, n=61,497 rows, 2026-08-30 -> 2026-09-02), which MEETS <=0.02. The widely-quoted 0.14 is STRUCTURAL_EXPANDED's own field `spread_proxy_q1`, unit '$ over 1.00' -- that is the TWO-LEG pair-cost excess (pair_cost - 1.00), not a single-leg spread. This dimension passes; the venue fails elsewhere.
R7_maker_adverse_selection: unrebated maker P&L -$0.2380/contract [-0.2831,-0.1935] on 10,698 evidenced maker fills / 46 windows, against a -$0.0046 tolerance -- 52x worse; 0 non-toxic states in every bin of every pre-fill feature
R8_fees: no per-fill charged-fee schedule sourced for our account on this venue in this corpus
R9_incentives: no credited rebate or reward evidence for our account at Gemini BTC5M
R10_executable_capacity: depth is adequate (R5) but capacity is moot: the sequential sub-$1 pair exists in only 47.1% of windows and only after ~175s, so a $316 median outlay at concurrency 2 has nothing to execute into

gemini_btc5m.binding_requirement: R3 (trade density) and R2 (complement/switch latency), jointly. R3 is the more absolute of the two: venue-wide flow is a median 5 prints per 5-minute window against a >=30 own-trades/min requirement, so the cadence is unreachable by ~30x no matter how the policy is tuned. R2 then independently blocks it: the sub-$1 pair is NEVER reachable inside 60s, median first lock 174.6s, so 71.2% completion is required against 47.1% available. Depth (R5) and single-leg spread (R6) are explicitly NOT the constraints.

verdict.any_venue_passes: ONLY THE REFERENCE VENUE, AND CIRCULARLY
verdict.statement: Exactly ONE venue-category passes the mechanism requirements -- Polymarket crypto up/down, the venue L5 actually operated in -- and it passes CIRCULARLY, because R1-R10 were derived from L5's behaviour on it. Even there, three requirements are UNAVAILABLE (R5 depth, R6 spread, R7 maker adverse selection) because no book tape for that venue is on disk: we can show the strategy worked for L5 there, not that OUR account can execute it. NO INDEPENDENT venue passes. Among the alternatives: Gemini BTC5M fails 6 of 10, with trade density short by ~30x and the sequential sub-$1 pair never reachable inside 60s; Kalshi 15m has a hard pair-cost floor (0 sub-$1 in 2,269 AND in 2,409 independent rows, minimum 1.001) and $0 credited maker compensation; Polymarket sports is killed outright by 1000 bps maker AND taker fees; the PMUS BBO file is an evidence gate, not a venue finding. Gemini BTC15M is the only alternative that passes every dimension its data CAN measure (R4 window, R5 depth, R6 spread) -- but 7 of 10 are UNAVAILABLE and, decisively, its tape carries the UP leg only in 23,318/23,318 rows, so both mechanism requirements are not merely unmeasured but UNMEASURABLE from existing data. It is UNDETERMINED, not passing, and it is the single highest-value place to point a new two-leg recorder.
